notablePrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Avenger of Zendikar that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Avenger of Zendikar token enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating at least five 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar six times by sacrificing six creature tokens, adding {6}.
Repeat.
If you control six or more lands, this combo nets infinite colored mana and creature tokens.
